template_import.source_steps.message: To get a file, open Zabbix 7.4 → Data collection → Templates, select the templates and click Export. Save the YAML, JSON or XML file, then choose it here.

template_import.server_future.message: Importing templates directly from a connected Zabbix server will be available in a later step.

template_import.catalog_use_later.message: Use saved catalogs to build a local page in Drafts. Select catalog versions and metrics there; the page keeps its selected copies.

template_import.help.message: Choose Zabbix 7.4 template exports in YAML, JSON or XML. Review the result before saving catalogs on this computer.

template_import.empty.message: No metric catalogs have been saved yet.

template_import.action_failed.message: The file operation failed. Inspect the files again before retrying.

template_import.list_failed.message: The local metric library could not be read.

template_import.becomes.message: Metric catalogs to save: {count}, one per template.

template_import.preview_counts.message: Metrics: {metrics}. Discovery rules: {rules}. Metrics with preview hints: {hints}.

template_import.new_version.message: A new version will be saved. Earlier versions are kept.

template_import.partial.message: This catalog is incomplete: unsupported or unfamiliar source fields were skipped, including any template dashboards.

template_import.lld_requires_instance.message: Discovery prototypes need a concrete discovered item before they can be used.

template_import.missing_parent.message: A parent template is missing from this export.

template_import.unresolved_macros.message: Some macro values require additional context.
